# Sword

![Sword](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/sword.png)

Steady points on Heads.

- **Rarity:** Common
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 12 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 5 points

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
